entities.name: Planeswalker
entities.description: A powerful spellcaster able to travel between planes via the Blind Eternities; once near-omnipotent, now mostly ordinary beings since the Mending.

entities.name: Spark
entities.description: An imprint of aether from the Blind Eternities on a soul that lets a Planeswalker traverse it in relative safety.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes through which Planeswalkers travel.

entities.name: The Mending
entities.description: The event in which Jeska sacrificed her life and spark to mend temporal rifts, changing Planeswalkers and their sparks.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion whose consequences caused many Planeswalkers to lose their sparks.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: A planeswalker who sacrificed her life and spark to cause the Mending.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: The embodiment of Dominarian magic, Jeska's former existence.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: A Dominarian artificer in whom the new breed of Planeswalker first manifested.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who theorized that the rifts mutated Venser's spark and described his first planeswalk.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A planeswalker dragon who carried Nicol Bolas to the Meditation Plane in his wings.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An Elder Dragon who was injured and blinded when Ugin carried him through the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Jiang Yanggu
entities.description: A planeswalker who can planeswalk with his dog Mowu.

entities.name: Kaya Cassir
entities.description: A planeswalker who can merge with another being and take them along on a planeswalk.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: An angel and former human who is an exception to the rule that angels lack sparks.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A demon and former human who is an exception to the rule that demons lack sparks.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The Nexus of the Multiverse, where the Mending took place.

events.summary: Jeska sacrifices her life and spark to mend all temporal rifts in the Multiverse, an event that changes the nature of Planeswalker sparks.
events.quote: Jeska sacrificed her life and her spark to mend all temporal rifts in the Multiverse

events.summary: The new breed of Planeswalker first manifests in Venser of Urborg.
events.quote: The new breed manifested itself for the first time in Venser of Urborg

events.summary: Ugin brings Nicol Bolas to the Meditation Plane wrapped in his wings; the Blind Eternities injure and blind Bolas.
events.quote: Ugin was able to bring Nicol Bolas to the Meditation Plane wrapped in his wings

events.summary: The consequences of the New Phyrexian Invasion cause many Planeswalkers to lose their sparks.
events.quote: the consequences of the New Phyrexian Invasion caused many Planeswalkers to lose their sparks

relations.note: Jeska was formerly Karona, the embodiment of Dominarian magic.
He can planeswalk with his dog Mowu.
relations.quote: Jiang Yanggu can planeswalk with his dog Mowu

relations.note: Ugin carried Bolas through the Blind Eternities, injuring him.
relations.quote: Ugin was able to bring Nicol Bolas to the Meditation Plane wrapped in his wings
